display_name: Session B (Broker 21:00-04:00, Buy inside / Flat outside)

logic.summary: Long-only time-window model: hold a buy during broker server time 21:00-04:00 and stay flat outside the window.
logic.economic_rationale: Variant of Session A with earlier entry and earlier exit to test sensitivity of the overnight drift hypothesis.
known_assumptions: Hours are broker SERVER time, not UTC.
Highly correlated with Session A; counts as a related, not independent, trial.
rejection_criteria: Adds no diversification versus Session A (return correlation > 0.9).
Negative Out-of-Sample expectancy after spread and swap.
